verified: World Nuclear News reports that hot tests are complete for Tianwan unit 8 and that its initial fuel load has been delivered.
unconfirmed: No start-up date, grid-connection date or commercial operation date is given, and no independent confirmation of the testing results is available; the "world's largest nuclear power plant" description rests on the site's expectation that all eight units will eventually operate.

verified: 世界核新闻（World Nuclear News）报道，田湾8号机组已完成热试，首炉核燃料已运抵现场。
unconfirmed: 8号机组何时首次临界、并网发电和投入商业运行；全厂八台机组的总装机容量；“全部投运后成为全球最大核电站”这一定性判断，报道未给出与其他核电站的容量对比数据。

titles.en: Tianwan unit 8 completes hot tests and takes first fuel load
titles.zh: 田湾8号机组完成热试并接收首炉核燃料
